title: Quenched Bitter American Beef Tagine
description: A rich and velvety beef dish cooked to perfection in a tagine, perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: Preheat the tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil and sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it's softened and lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the red wine to the pot and cook until it's reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and browned beef to the pot.
Return the pot to the stovetop over low heat and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
